# Resonance YouTube Optimizer

> Resonance YouTube Optimizer provides AI-powered YouTube channel audits, content strategy, thumbnails, and growth analytics as part of The Resonance Hub.

The app is currently available at no charge under the Resonance Free Access Promotion while real AI, thumbnail-generation, infrastructure, and support costs are measured.

## Promotion access

- No payment, checkout, credit pack, or subscription is required during the promotion.
- Sign-in may still be required so audits and generated assets can persist and usage can be measured.
- Future pricing has not been established and will require a new governed release after costing is validated.

## Hub

- [The Resonance Hub](https://reson8.life): Ecosystem home, governance, updates, and support.
- [Free access promotion](https://reson8.life/pricing): Current suite-wide promotion status.
- [Hub updates](https://reson8.life/updates): Release notes across the ecosystem.
